description_en: Modify the resource group to which a domain name belongs
description_zh: 修改域名所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun domain change-resource-group --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang zh --resource-id S20227H17A561968 --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2tcx7os7bkmq --resource-type Domain --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language in which error messages are returned by the API. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

Default value: **zh**
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
- **zh**：中文。
- **en**：英文。

默认为**zh**
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The resource ID of the domain name
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to shift the domain name.

You can view the resource group ID in the [Resource Management Console](https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups)
parameters.help_zh:
要移动到的资源组ID。

您可以通过[资源管理控制台](https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups)查看资源组ID
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type of the domain name. This parameter is fixed to “Domain” and does not need to be specified
parameters.help_zh: 域名资源类型，固定为“Domain”，不需要填写
parameters.name: resource_type
